data.name: CountNote
data.value: The count checks, before the UPDATE, that the statement still returns the confirmed rows.

data.name: BatchNote
data.value: The keys go in batches of up to 1,000.

data.name: JoinReason
data.value: in a join result, the whole column cannot be changed: choose the column's cells (drag, or Shift+click), and the edit applies to them

data.name: NotReadReason
data.value: the whole column runs the result's statement again, and it is not read-only

data.name: LimitReason
data.value: the statement limits the rows without an order, and the database may pick other rows when it runs again: add an ORDER BY, or choose the column's cells

data.name: SampleReason
data.value: the statement samples the rows, and the database would pick other ones when it runs again: choose the column's cells

data.name: TooManyKeysReason
data.value: the statement returns more than 1,000,000 rows, and in this database the whole column of a statement with a row limit reads the keys first: remove the limit from the statement, or change it in parts

data.name: KeyReason
data.value: {0} is part of the key of {1}: on the whole column, all the rows would end up with the same key

data.name: RepeatedKeyReason
data.value: {0}, from the key of {1}, appears with the same name in more than one column of the result

data.name: CountChanged
data.value: The result changed since the count: the statement now returns {0}, and not {1}. Nothing was written; save again to count once more.

data.name: UpdateChanged
data.value: The result changed since the count: the statement changed {0}, and not {1}. Nothing was written; save again to count once more. If the number repeats in the following attempts, the cause may be a trigger, a rule or a cascade of the database, which the count does not see.

data.name: WrittenAnyway
data.value: The whole column was changed in {0}, and not in {1}: the result changed since the count. This database has no transaction log, and the change stayed written.

data.name: CountedOne
data.value: the 1 counted

data.name: CountedMany
data.value: the {0} counted

data.name: LinesOne
data.value: 1 row

data.name: LinesMany
data.value: {0} rows

data.name: ConfirmedOne
data.value: the 1 confirmed

data.name: ConfirmedMany
data.value: the {0} confirmed

data.name: NotSupported
data.value: The whole column cannot be changed in this result: {0}.

data.name: SeveralWholeChanges
data.value: The request has more than one whole-column change: send just one, with all the columns in the set.

data.name: CountTakesOnlyWhole
data.value: The count takes only the whole-column change (updateAll).

data.name: CountNeedsWhole
data.value: The count needs the whole-column change (updateAll).

data.name: RowsMissing
data.value: State how many rows the count gave (rows).

data.name: RowsInvalid
data.value: The number of rows (rows) must be an integer from 0 up.

data.name: TableNotInResult
data.value: The change's table does not exist in this result.

data.name: TableNotEditable
data.value: The change's table cannot be edited: {0}.

data.name: WholeChangeHasNoColumn
data.value: The whole-column change has no column.

data.name: ColumnNotInResult
data.value: The column does not exist in the result.

data.name: ColumnNotInTable
data.value: The column does not belong to the change's table.

data.name: ColumnNotEditable
data.value: The column cannot be edited: {0}.

data.name: ColumnRepeated
data.value: The same column appears twice in the change.
